title: Just Juice Bar Below Zero Blackcurrant Honeydew 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Blackcurrant Honeydew from the Just Juice Bar Below Zero Range brings together two contrasting fruit notes in a smooth Nic Salt blend. Dark, tangy Blackcurrant delivers a delightfully sweet sharpness and depth, balanced by the light, mellow freshness of Honeydew Melon for a complex, balanced fruit vape rounded off with a cool, crisp exhale. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid delivers fast-acting satisfaction with a comfortable throat feel, ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping in pod kits and vape pens. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg strengths, it offers a versatile option to suit different preferences. Made in the UK, Just Juice Bar Below Zero Range Nic Salts are blended at 60PG/40VG to provide clear flavour with subtle vapour, capturing the sweet-chilled profiles popular in disposable-style blends, now available in a refillable 10ml format. Please Note : All flavours in the Just Juice Bar Below Zero Range feature a subtle hint of ice to enhance the flavour profile.
